settings.title: Trashcan Reminder Settings
settings.description: Please note that not all cities are supported. You can check availability by providing your postal code and house number to see if it's supported. If the address isn't supported, you can always add the pattern via the manual input settings below and still be able to use the full functionalities of the app!
settings.manualonly: The data was refreshed based on the manual settings only

manualdata.title: Advanced Date Entry
manualdata.description: Via this field you can add (extra) dates. This is not recommended, but for advanced users only. The dates should be entered in the format YYYY-mm-dd.

manualremove.title: Advanced Date Removal
manualremove.description: Via this field you can remove dates from the generated sequence. This is not recommended, but for advanced users only. The dates should be entered in the format YYYY-mm-dd.

settings.labeldescription: The values entered below are used to customize your trash experience. The values are used in the global tags available in your flows, in the widget and set in labels on cards available in advanced flows.
settings.genericlabelhelper: Variables that can be used in the global tag sentence are __time__, __type__, __plural__.
settings.timeindicatorDescription: This is used to render the examples below your label settings, to give a sneak preview of the text available through the three global labels.

instructions.streetNumber: Enter your street name and house number as they appear on your waste calendar, for example 'Roskildevej' and '40'.
instructions.vestfor: Enter your street, house number and 4-digit postcode, for example 'Kløvertoften', '61' and '2740'.
instructions.odense: Go to https://mit.odenserenovation.dk/hentkalender and look up your address. Copy the number after 'addressNo=' from the page address (for example 133517) into the field below.
instructions.renosyd: Enter the customer (house) number from your Renosyd waste collection. The number is padded to 6 digits automatically, for example 013000.
instructions.renoDjurs: Log in on https://minside.renodjurs.dk. The number after 'id=' in the page address is your customer ID, for example 46000.
instructions.kalundborg: Go to https://kalundborg.infovision.dk/public/selectaddress and search for your address. The address ID is the last part of the page address, for example 00006ac8-0002-0001-4164-647265737320.
instructions.kolding: Go to https://kolding.infovision.dk/public/selectaddress and search for your address. The address ID is the last part of the page address, for example 00007b8d-0002-0001-4164-647265737320.
